title: Thunderbird Anroid not clearing emails once I clear them offof server
creator: jack.dawson
content:
Current Thunderbird setup: Computer: Pop3 Phone IMAP

Until last week, I could leave the emails on my phone all day until I accessed them on the POP3 setup on my computer. That would remove the emails on the server and when I went back to my phone, it would show an empty inbox. Now, the emails do not clear out of my inbox on the phone, and I have to delete them manually. This happens on both the production version and the Beta version. Also, accessing via webmail, the inbox will be empty after accessing email on my computer.
